conviction_note: The quarter and a third 2026 raise both went out by MAR ad-hoc on 29 Oct (stock +13.2% that day, -7.2% the next), so 4 Nov is a confirmation report with a call. The only new lines are the size of the one-off gains inside the 22.5% margin, Q4 and supply commentary, and backlog. The guide moved six days ago and is not expected to move again, so abs_move is held near the pre-released base (3%) and lifted to 4% for 70% realised vol and a +14% five-day run-up. p_up 45 reflects 3 of 3 prior confirmation days closing lower (-3.1%, -2.1%, -1.1%) and the last two raises being sold. Findings sum -0.8 and the scaled number is -0.4: same sign, and both small because nothing found is an unpriced company-level number.

already_public.what: Preliminary 9M 2026 numbers: orders EUR 278.6m (+62%), sales EUR 227.4m (+35%), EBIT EUR 51.1m, margin 22.5%, FCF EUR 31.0m. 2026 guide raised to sales EUR 295-300m (was 270-290) and EBIT margin 17.5-19.5% (was 12.5-14.5). MAR Art. 17 ad-hoc.

Implied Q4: revenue about EUR 67.6-72.6m, below Q3's EUR 75.0m. Implied Q4 EBIT about EUR 0.5-7.4m, because of special employee payments and one-offs. Sony Kumamoto sensor shortfall in Sep/Oct. Press arithmetic is already in circulation.
H1 2026 results and second raise (to EUR 270-290m). dpa-AFX: Bloomberg consensus was already about EUR 280m sales; the stock gapped +5% and closed -7.0%.
Directors' Dealings: CCO/COO Hardy Mehl bought EUR 50,027 at EUR 24.17 on XETRA on 29 Oct.

new_in_release.expect: The 9M report should put a number on the 'positive one-time effects' inside the 22.5% EBIT margin. The underlying margin is lower than the headline. Mildly negative.

Q4 and supply commentary on the Sony Kumamoto sensor shortage, plus order backlog (9M orders exceed sales by EUR 51m). Could lean positive if management signals the top of the EUR 295-300m range or a strong 2027 start. Unknown.
No change expected; the guide was raised on 29 Oct. A first 2027 indication is possible on the call but not signalled. Unknown.
9M FCF EUR 31.0m is already out (implied Q3 about EUR 18m); working-capital detail is new but likely neutral.
Confirms the pre-release; expect no deviation.

findings.finding: The 29 Oct ad-hoc says 'positive one-time effects' inflate the 9M EBIT margin of 22.5% and that 'some of these effects are non-recurring', without a number. The 4 Nov report and call are where that number appears, so the underlying margin will be shown below the headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Basler one-off quantification was found. On the closest analogue, the H1 report (Aug 2026, margin 20.4% against a guide of 12.5-14.5%), the stock gapped +4.7% and closed -7.0%. The stage's European lesson: a beat made of a one-off is sold (H&M).
findings.original_quote: In addition to very strong operating performance, high production capacity utilization, and the efficiency measures implemented, positive one-time effects contributed to the earnings performance; however, some of these effects are non-recurring.
findings.why_not_priced: The size of the one-offs has not been disclosed, so no estimate can carry it yet. If it were priced, the stock would have held its 29 Oct +13% rather than giving back 7% the next day; it gave back half, which suggests it is partly priced. That is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The implied Q4 EBIT of EUR 0.5-7.4m in the drweb arithmetic (https://www.drweb.de/basler-prognose-sony-sensoren/) points the same way: the full-year margin guide sits far below the 9M run-rate. It rests on the same guide, so it is not fully independent.

findings.finding: The sensor constraint behind the conservative Q4 guide may be easing. Orders ran EUR 51m ahead of sales over 9M (book-to-bill about 1.23; Q3 orders EUR 98.6m against sales EUR 75.0m), and Sony's Kumamoto sensor plant was reported back to pre-quake output on 19 Aug. So the call could steer to the top of EUR 295-300m or to a strong 2027 start.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Raised guides were sold: Aug 2026 -7.0% on the day, 29 Oct +13.2% then -7.2% the next day. In Oct-Nov 2025 the raise and confirmation days went -2.0% and -2.1% (after a +5% gap). Backlog commentary alone has not produced a positive close on a confirmation day in the three observed.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide was set on 29 Oct, after Sony's recovery, and still names the Kumamoto impact, so management has not yet credited the recovery. A priced recovery would show sell-side moving above the top of the range, and nothing like that was found. This is inference from a counterparty's secondary-sourced recovery plus the company's own order numbers, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Basler's own 9M orders against sales, in the 29 Oct ad-hoc (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/basler-ag-preliminary-9-month-result-again-increase-of-forecast-2026-after-continued-high-incoming-orders-and-strong-results/24df783a-623e-4ad0-8689-110bd3ecf6b5_en). Different document, same company.

findings.finding: Basler's confirmation-report days after a pre-release closed lower 3 of 3 times: -3.07% on 2024-11-07, -2.11% on 2025-11-06 (after a +5.1% gap), -1.08% on 2026-05-06. The stock runs into this one up 14.25% over five sessions and +6.6% intraday on 11-03.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This finding is the reaction history: three confirmation days, all lower, median -2.1%. Raises sold on 2026-08-05 (-7.0%) and 2026-10-30 (-7.2%).
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is the free control and this agrees with it, so it is partly priced, which is why it is sized at -1.0 rather than the -2.1 median. What is not priced is the pattern of selling into the confirmation call on a thinly covered SDax name. If it were priced, the five-day run-up would not have extended into the day before.
